description: Create a NEW Vivideo account for your user by paying for a plan (works without an API key). Returns a Stripe checkout_url: SHOW THIS LINK TO YOUR USER, who pays there (card, Link or Apple Pay) — the only human step. Then call get_signup_status with the checkout_id; once paid, the API key is saved and used automatically. If the email already has an account this returns error account_exists: use request_login_code + verify_login_code instead (payment never opens an existing account). The claim token stays inside this server and is never returned.

email.description: Your user's email; the new account is created for it.

name: start_signup
